say:3:1220218001:1.text: You're just in time. The barkeep said...
say:3:1220218001:1.source_cn: 卢卡先生，你来的正好。酒保先生说……

narration:4:1220218002:0.text: You tell Lucca what just occurred.
narration:4:1220218002:0.source_cn: 把刚才发生的事告诉了卢卡……

say:5:1220218003:1.text: Those dimwits! I'll handle them. They won't cause any more trouble, I swear.
say:5:1220218003:1.source_cn: 那几个蠢货，我会教训他们的，不会让他们再闹笑话！

say:6:1220218004:0.text: But even so, that won't stop them from drinking. The real issue is the lack of water in Rustport.
say:6:1220218004:0.source_cn: 但就算这样也没法阻止他们喝酒吧，这个问题的本质原因，是...

say:7:1220218005:0.text: Is it because Rustport was just unsealed? Or is there a problem with the city's water filters?
say:7:1220218005:0.source_cn: 是因为锈锚港刚刚解封吗？还是净水管道出了故障呢？。

say:9:1220218006:0.text: It's mainly because the water filters are old. There's barely enough drinkable water for everyone.
say:9:1220218006:0.source_cn: 主要是净水管道老化，日常供水勉强能用，但是用来喝的净水...

say:10:1220218007:0.text: I'm actually planning on finding a craftsman to upgrade the purification system.
say:10:1220218007:0.source_cn: 其实，我正打算找个工匠升级一下净水系统——

say:11:1220218008:0.text: A craftsman? Wouldn't Hugin be best for the job?
say:11:1220218008:0.source_cn: 工匠？呼金不就是最好的工匠吗？

choice_prompt:12:1220218008.text: A craftsman? Wouldn't Hugin be best for the job?
choice_prompt:12:1220218008.source_cn: 工匠？呼金不就是最好的工匠吗？

say:13:1220218009:1.source_cn: 问问呼金不就知道了？我们去找他吧！

say:14:1220218010:1.text: But do you think a filtration system would be enough of a challenge for Hugin? It does sound pretty generic...
say:14:1220218010:1.source_cn: 不过，滤水系统，对于呼金来说真的是个需要创意的挑战性工作吗？

choice_prompt:15:1220218010.text: But do you think a filtration system would be enough of a challenge for Hugin? It does sound pretty generic...
choice_prompt:15:1220218010.source_cn: 不过，滤水系统，对于呼金来说真的是个需要创意的挑战性工作吗？

say:16:1220218011:0.text: Hm? Do you have a plan on how to convince Hugin?
say:16:1220218011:0.source_cn: 计划？梅林想好怎么说服呼金了吗？
say:16:1220218011:0.male: Hm? Do you have a plan on how to convince Hugin?
say:16:1220218011:0.female: Hm? Do you have a plan on how to convince Hugin?

narration:17:1220218012:0.text: You tell Hammie and Chippy your plan...
narration:17:1220218012:0.source_cn: 向满满和漫漫讲述了之后的说服计划……

choice:12:1:2.text: Why not have him do it?
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 让呼金发明滤水系统吧
choice:12:1:2.male: Why not have him do it?
choice:12:1:2.female: Why not have him do it?
